task_name: Reorder endpoint — bucket positions without version bumps

strengths: PATCH /tracker/items/:key/position implemented with beforeKey/afterKey neighbor semantics matching the plan
loadBucketSiblings uses COALESCE(position, 1e15) for defensive NULL ordering as required
Rebalance-on-RangeError follows cards.ts precedent; only position is written (no version or updated_at)
recordTrackerActivity and publishEvent called; cross-bucket body fields rejected with 400
All five plan tests pass (midpoint move, version/updated_at untouched, rebalance, cross-workspace 404, cross-bucket 400)

issues.description: Tests mock recordTrackerActivity but never assert it was called with changed: ["position"] — quality-bar must-have is implemented but untested
Handler returns 400 for neighbor-not-in-bucket but no test covers that path
Moved item row is read outside the transaction without forUpdate (cards.ts locks the moved row inside trx); low risk for reorder-only writes but slightly weaker concurrency safety
